source_text: Incedamus et omnia secundum ordinem geramus. Si nihil inordinatum, nihil inquietum, nihil inhonestum in nobis inventum fuerit, tunc sicut sol fulgebimus in regno. Cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let-us-advance and all-things according-to order let-us-conduct. If nothing disordered, nothing restless, nothing shameful in us will-have-been-found, then as sun we-will-shine in kingdom. To-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Let us walk and [[do all things in order >> Bible:1 Corinthians 14:40]]. If nothing disordered, restless, or shameful is found in us, then we shall [[shine like the sun in the kingdom >> Bible:Matthew 13:43]]. To him be glory forever. Homilia I CLOSEOUT. Amen.
